expanded_element.description: Nam phrik (Thai: น้ำพริก , pronounced [ná(ː)m pʰrík̚] ) is a type of Thai spicy chili sauce typical of Thai cuisine. Usual ingredients for nam phrik-type sauces are fresh or dry chilies, garlic, shallots, lime juice and often some kind of fish or shrimp paste.
